moments.title: Premier League Sunday Showdowns
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up four exciting fixtures today, rounding off Matchweek 5, including Fulham hosting Manchester United.

angles.name: Match Day Vibe
angles.copy: Sunday. Premier League. That's the vibe. Four big games today including Fulham v Man Utd to finish Matchweek 5. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Man Utd Focus
angles.copy: Fulham take on Manchester United at Craven Cottage today. Can the home side cause an upset on this Premier League Sunday?

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Gallagher Premiership Rugby season is officially underway this weekend, with Round 1 matches happening across the UK, including Exeter Chiefs playing Leicester Tigers today.

angles.name: Season Start Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! Gallagher Premiership Rugby is BACK. Who's ready for a season of thrilling tackles and tries?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Local Angle
angles.copy: Our very own Exeter Chiefs are in action today as the Gallagher Premiership Rugby season kicks off! Good luck, lads! #ExeterChiefs

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Live Shows Begin
moments.blurb: After last night's launch show, the first live competitive dances of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 are just around the corner, starting next Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Strictly Hype
angles.copy: The pairings are done, the glitterball is polished. Now, the real work begins! Strictly's first live show is next Saturday. Who's your early favourite?

angles.name: New Hosts Takeover
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are officially in the Strictly ballroom! What do you make of the new presenting trio after the launch show?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Series 17 Starts
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22nd at 8pm on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Excitement
angles.copy: Get your spatulas ready! The Great British Bake Off is back this Tuesday on Channel 4. Who's excited for Cake Week?

angles.name: New Judge Intrigue
angles.copy: A new ingredient in the tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for Bake Off Series 17, starting Tuesday. What will she bring to the table?

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Jarvis Cocker
moments.blurb: Today, September 20th, marks the 63rd birthday of Pulp frontman and Britpop icon, Jarvis Cocker.

angles.name: Britpop Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the inimitable Jarvis Cocker! What's your favourite Pulp track to get you dancing like 'Common People'?

angles.name: Pulp Anthem
angles.copy: A true legend turns 63 today! Jarvis Cocker, frontman of Pulp, gave us some of the most iconic Britpop anthems. Which one's on your playlist?

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Concludes Today
moments.blurb: England's Heritage Open Days festival, offering free access to historical sites and events, wraps up today, September 20th.

angles.name: Last Chance Culture
angles.copy: Last chance! Heritage Open Days across England conclude today, offering a final opportunity to explore hidden gems for free. Did you visit anywhere special?

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Abergavenny Food Festival, a celebration of Welsh produce and culinary talent, concludes today, September 20th.

angles.name: Foodie Farewell
angles.copy: The delicious Abergavenny Food Festival finishes today! Hope everyone enjoyed the incredible Welsh produce and chef demos. What was your favourite bite?

angles.name: Local Food Highlight
angles.copy: That's a wrap for the Abergavenny Food Festival! A fantastic showcase for Welsh food and drink. What local producers did you discover?

moments.title: York Food & Drink Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The York Food & Drink Festival, one of Britain's biggest foodie events, is in full swing until September 27th, celebrating local and regional produce.

angles.name: Yorkshire Foodie Fun
angles.copy: York's Food & Drink Festival is ON! If you're in Yorkshire, get down there before Sept 27th for tastings, demos and the best local grub.

moments.title: Joan Jett Turns 68
moments.blurb: Rock and Roll Hall of Famer Joan Jett, known for 'I Love Rock 'n Roll', celebrates her 68th birthday on September 22nd.

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: The legendary Joan Jett turns 68 on Tuesday! Still rockin' the world. What's your favourite track from the 'Queen of Noise'?

angles.name: Iconic Anthems
angles.copy: 'I Love Rock 'n Roll' is still an absolute anthem! Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Joan Jett this Tuesday!

moments.title: David Coverdale's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Whitesnake and ex-Deep Purple frontman, David Coverdale, celebrates his 75th birthday on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Rock Vocal Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the voice behind Deep Purple and Whitesnake, David Coverdale! Still got that incredible vocal power.

moments.title: Chesney Hawkes Turns 55
moments.blurb: The one and only Chesney Hawkes, famous for 'The One and Only', celebrates his 55th birthday on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Still The One
angles.copy: He's still 'The One and Only'! Happy 55th Birthday to Chesney Hawkes this Tuesday. That song is still an absolute banger!

moments.title: Great British Harvest Festival in Suffolk
moments.blurb: St Edmundsbury Cathedral in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, hosts The Great British Harvest Festival on Saturday, September 26th, featuring music from Nik Kershaw and Chesney Hawkes.

angles.name: Suffolk Gig Alert
angles.copy: Big gig alert for Suffolk! The Great British Harvest Festival is at St Edmundsbury Cathedral this Saturday, with Nik Kershaw and Chesney Hawkes performing. Grab your picnic!

angles.name: Harvest Festival Music
angles.copy: Celebrating the harvest with some serious tunes! Nik Kershaw and Chesney Hawkes are playing The Great British Harvest Festival in Bury St Edmunds this Saturday. What a lineup!

moments.title: King George's Hall Blackburn Reopens
moments.blurb: Blackburn's iconic King George's Hall reopens its doors on Saturday, September 26th, after extensive renovations, with a programme including Jason Donovan and David Essex.

angles.name: Blackburn Venue Back
angles.copy: Fantastic news for Blackburn! King George's Hall reopens this Saturday after a huge refurb, with gigs from Jason Donovan and David Essex. Who's heading there?

moments.title: Latest UK Singles Chart News
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending September 26th features new entries from Adela, Jamie Miller, and re-entries from Oasis and TLC.

angles.name: Chart Rundown
angles.copy: New music and some classics making a comeback! The latest UK Singles Chart (week ending Sept 26) sees new entries from Adela and Jamie Miller, plus Oasis and TLC are back in the Top 40!

angles.name: Oasis Chart Return
angles.copy: Don't Look Back In Anger... just celebrate its return to the UK Singles Chart! Oasis are back in the Top 40 this week.

moments.title: Sense and Sensibility Film Release
moments.blurb: A new film adaptation of Jane Austen's 'Sense and Sensibility', filmed in Dartmoor and Devon, is set for release on September 26th.

angles.name: Local Film Pride
angles.copy: Mark your calendars, Devon! A new 'Sense and Sensibility' film, shot right here in Dartmoor and Devon, hits screens on September 26th. Get ready to spot familiar scenes!

angles.name: Austen in Devon
angles.copy: Jane Austen meets Dartmoor! The new 'Sense and Sensibility' film, filmed locally, is out next Saturday. Who's excited for some period drama with a Westcountry backdrop?

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex has launched its annual Pumpkin Festival, running from September 19th to October 31st, featuring over a million pumpkins.

angles.name: Pumpkin Season Kicks Off
angles.copy: Pumpkin season has officially begun! Tulleys Farm in West Sussex is already showcasing over a million pumpkins. Who's planning a visit for some autumnal fun?

moments.title: Avril Lavigne's 42nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Pop-punk princess Avril Lavigne celebrates her 42nd birthday on Sunday, September 27th.

angles.name: Sk8er Boi Forever
angles.copy: Can you believe Avril Lavigne turns 42 this Sunday? The pop-punk icon is still rocking! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Brixton Windmill Harvest Festival
moments.blurb: Brixton Windmill & Education Centre hosts its free family Harvest Festival on Sunday, September 27th, celebrating the annual wheat harvest with workshops, music, and food.

angles.name: London Harvest Fun
angles.copy: Head to Brixton Windmill this Sunday for their free Harvest Festival! Expect milling demos, craft workshops, live music, and plenty of food.
